description: This file defines a Joystick class for handling virtual joystick input in Unity, including axis configuration, virtual axis creation, and input handling methods.

classes.name: Joystick
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour class implementing a virtual joystick with configurable axes, handling drag and pointer events.

methods.name: OnEnable
methods.description: Initializes virtual axes when the object is enabled.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Stores the initial position of the joystick.

methods.name: UpdateVirtualAxes
methods.description: Updates the virtual axes based on joystick movement.

methods.name: CreateVirtualAxes
methods.description: Creates and registers virtual axes based on configuration.

methods.name: OnDrag
methods.description: Handles drag events to move the joystick and update axes.

methods.name: OnPointerUp
methods.description: Resets joystick position and axes when pointer is released.

methods.name: OnPointerDown
methods.description: Empty handler for pointer down event.

methods.name: OnDisable
methods.description: Removes virtual axes when the object is disabled.
